shortDescription: BPSSC Havildar Instructor (Home Guard) Advt 06/2026 Admit Card was out; EXAM POSTPONED. New date will be announced on bpssc.bihar.gov.in.
content:
BPSSC had activated e-Admit Card download for Havildar Instructor (From Bihar Home Guard) under Advt. No. 06/2026.

Update: The written examination has been postponed. Candidates should not appear on the earlier notified date. A fresh schedule will be published on the official website.

Portal: bpssc.bihar.gov.in / apply-bpssc.com — keep checking Notices for the new date.
